company_name: NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ ADS; 1 ADS = 5 ordinary shares; primary listing HKEX 9999.HK)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: H1-2026 actual revenue growth (+7.0%) and management's mid-to-high single-digit framing, cross-checked against revenue CAGRs; NOT the equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: FLAGGED: equity CAGR (14.9% 3yr and 5yr) is ~2.8x the 3yr revenue CAGR (5.3%), and the owner-FCF 3yr CAGR (27.5%) is >5x it. The gap is margin expansion (gaming gross margin 70% -> 76% on lower platform revenue-sharing), retained cash and working-capital timing, not volume. Equity also compounds the RMB167bn treasury, which this model carries separately in the bridge -- using it as the growth driver would count the cash twice. Revenue growth of 7.5% decelerating to 3% is used instead.
historical_growth.notes: Computed from NTES_Metrics.csv (CNY millions, FY = calendar year). 3yr = FY2022->FY2025, 5yr = FY2020->FY2025. Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less net interest income): FY2020 19,570.5 / FY2022 20,285.1 / FY2025 42,073.3. The owner-FCF CAGR is ABOVE reported-FCF CAGR (27.5% vs 24.7%), so SBC is not growing faster than cash flow -- SBC is ~3% of revenue and flat. EPS CAGR uses diluted RMB per ordinary share.

scenario_narratives.base: NetEase compounds its evergreen domestic franchise base (Fantasy Westward Journey, Identity V, Eggy Party) at mid-single digits while the international titles add a few points of growth that fade as they mature. The Q2-2026 operating-leverage step (gaming gross margin 76.1%, operating margin 40.2%, opex +1.5%) holds roughly in place but does not extend. The tax step-up to ~22-24% is permanent. The treasury is returned steadily via buybacks and dividends, keeping the ADS count flat.
scenario_narratives.bull: NetEase becomes a genuinely global publisher: Where Winds Meet (100m+ cumulative players, on Game Pass since June 2026) and Marvel Rivals settle as multi-year evergreens, the Ananta / Blood Message pipeline delivers another worldwide hit, NPPA approvals keep running ahead of prior-year pace, and the direct-distribution margin gain proves structural as self-published international mix grows.
scenario_narratives.bear: The China policy tail bites again (a December-2023-style draft rule cut the stock 28% in one session) or the China consumer slows; Marvel Rivals churns like most hero-shooters; Sea of Remnants' rocky launch proves representative of the pipeline; Tencent's and miHoYo's far larger AI/R&D budgets erode NetEase's development edge; and the platform revenue-share gain reverses, taking margins back to FY2022-23 levels. Cloud Music's rising profits leak more to its minority holders.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Ten years of OWNER free cash flow (reported FCF less SBC less interest income) built from components (adjusted EBITDA, SBC as % of revenue, D&A, a structurally higher cash tax rate, capex, working capital on the CHANGE in revenue), discounted at a 10.5% CNY-built WACC, plus a terminal value capped at 18x; add a HAIRCUT BROAD net cash of RMB150.1bn; divide by 644.32M ADS-equivalents (3,221.6M diluted ordinary / 5) and convert at USD/CNY 6.6987 to US$ per NTES ADS. NET CASH: the broad company definition (cash + current and non-current time deposits + restricted cash + short-term investments - loans = RMB167.5bn at 2026-06-30) is the right starting point because time deposits (RMB102bn) and short-term investments (RMB51bn) ARE the treasury; the narrow XBRL cash line (RMB22.8bn) omits ~85% of it and would understate value by ~US$32/ADS. The 10.4% haircut excludes restricted cash, marks short-term investments at 90% and takes 5% repatriation friction. Net cash is ~US$34/ADS, about 29% of the price.
key_risks_to_valuation: China gaming regulation: discretionary policy over ~70-75% of revenue; the December 2023 draft rule is the reference shock.
Margin reversal: the gaming gross-margin step from 70% to 76% rests on lower platform revenue-sharing; the bear case reverses it and that is the largest swing factor.
Tax: the jump to ~22% effective is treated as structural; a further loss of preferential status toward 25% is in the bear case.
FX: value is earned in CNY; a 5% RMB depreciation lowers the USD per-ADS value 5% one-for-one.
VIE and HFCAA: structural legal risk on the operating contracts and ADS delisting risk; the HKEX primary listing gives ADS holders a conversion path.
NCI leakage: Cloud Music (9899.HK) and Youdao (DAO) are consolidated with public minorities; rising subsidiary profits leak a growing share outside NetEase holders, not deducted separately here.
Net cash haircut is a judgment: full stated net cash adds ~US$4/ADS; a larger trapped-cash view subtracts.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (NTES) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 106.06-156.44. FX Yahoo USDCNY=X, CNH=X, HKD=X, CNYHKD=X 2026-10-03; cross-listing 9999.HK same API.
data_sources.financials: NTES_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL companyfacts, CNY millions, currency label corrected 2026-10-03); Q2-2026 6-K (research/9999.HK/Extracted/9999.HK_6K_Q2-2026.txt line 651 net cash; balance sheet lines 1457-1882) for the 2026-06-30 balance sheet, TTM SBC, interest income and diluted share count; FY2025 20-F for NCI.
data_sources.qualitative: NTES_Analysis.json (2026-10-04); 9999.HK_DCF.json (2026-08-29) for the adopted driver judgments; MEMORY 9999-netease note.

inputs.share_count_basis: PER-ADS BASIS. 3,221.6M fully diluted ordinary shares (Q2-2026 6-K diluted weighted average; the 6-K share row has SEVEN columns and 3,210.6M is the H1-2025 average, not Q2-2026) divided by the ADS ratio of 5 = 644.32M ADS-equivalents, so every per-share output is per NTES ADS. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The flat count is genuinely FUNDED: RMB20.2bn of FY2025 repurchases in financing outflow, and the ordinary count has fallen 3,349.8M (FY2020) -> 3,218.2M (FY2025).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F share-based compensation RMB3,647.7m (CSV StockBasedComp FY2025); TTM to 2026-06-30 RMB3,199.2m built from quarterly 6-K disclosure (same anchor as 9999.HK_DCF.json). NetEase publishes no separate equity-award withholding-tax line, so sbc_incl_equity_taxes equals the add-back.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements are CNY (RMB) millions; NTES quotes USD per ADS. fx_rate 0.149283 USD per CNY = 1 / 6.6987, Yahoo USDCNY=X (CNY=X) at 2026-10-03T21:32Z; offshore CNH=X 6.7044 and CNYHKD=X 1.1684 agree. The rate has moved from ~6.79 in early July to 6.70 (RMB appreciation), and the Q2-2026 6-K's own convenience translation (RMB167.5bn = US$24.7bn) implies ~6.78 at 2026-06-30. PARITY CHECK: 9999.HK closed HK$186.20 (2026-10-02 08:08Z) x 5 ordinary per ADS / HKD=X 7.8463 = US$118.65 vs NTES US$117.21 at the 2026-10-02 US close, a 1.2% gap across the session difference -- proves the ADS ratio (5), the direction and the quote basis. NOTE: 9999.HK_DCF.json (2026-08-29) converts at RMB/USD 7.20 and RMB/HKD 1.08, which were stale even at that date (spot was ~6.8 / ~1.15); its HKD values are understated by roughly 7-8% on FX alone. The CNY per-ADS twin is emitted by the build; the unsuffixed per-share values are USD per ADS, comparable to current_price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: 10.5% for all three scenarios, built in the flows' own currency (CNY), not a USD rate: China 10-year government yield ~1.8% + equity risk premium ~6.0% + ~2.7pp China-tech regulatory/VIE/geopolitical premium. Identical to the 9999.HK build for the same company. Risk is charged ONCE: the regulatory tail sits in the probability weights (bear 25%) and this single rate; no per-scenario WACC differences. No additional ADS/HFCAA premium is stacked on the NTES line because ADS holders can convert into the HKEX primary-listed ordinary shares, and the 1.2% parity gap shows the market charges none.
inputs.lease_treatment: None needed: US-GAAP 20-F filer; operating lease cost already sits inside operating expenses (and so inside adjusted EBITDA), and lease liabilities are excluded from total_debt. One treatment, consistently applied.
inputs.nci_treatment: Youdao (NYSE: DAO) and NetEase Cloud Music (HKEX: 9899) are separately listed, consolidated, non-wholly-owned subsidiaries, so the NCI is real and is not added back. It is charged once and it is currently small: FY2025 comprehensive income attributable to NCI and redeemable NCI was a LOSS of RMB932.6m (NCI absorbed losses, mainly Youdao's), and redeemable NCI on the balance sheet is RMB91.3m. Flows are anchored to consolidated operating income and divided by the parent share count; no separate NCI stock deduction is taken because Cloud Music's profitability is rising -- this is the flagged leakage risk (see key_risks) rather than an ignored one. A market-value NCI deduction (public float of 9899.HK and DAO) would be the alternative treatment; it is not taken alongside the flows, which would double-charge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, scenario-weighted, component build, per .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md routing -- NetEase is an asset-light, cash-generative operating company (gaming ~82-85% of revenue, capex <1% of revenue), the operating-company row, with the non-US adaptations (currency, NCI, excluded interest income) applied. The same company is valued under 9999.HK (2026-08-29) on the same model; this NTES build deliberately ADOPTS that file's driver paths, net-cash haircut, WACC and weights unchanged, because no new filing has arrived since (Q2-2026 6-K is the latest; Q3-2026 results are due mid-November). What changed vs that file is only the anchors: price, FX (refreshed and corrected) and the per-ADS share basis. Evidence that would move the drivers: the Q3-2026 6-K (gaming gross margin holding ~76% or not; effective tax rate staying ~21-22%; revenue growth vs the 7.5% Y1 path). HORIZON 10 years because the base owner-FCF margin is still drifting. *** NET CASH -- BROAD BASIS, HAIRCUT *** The CSV's narrow CashAndEquivalents (RMB47.2bn at FY2025; RMB22.8bn at 2026-06-30) is a fraction of the treasury. Company-stated net cash at 2026-06-30 is RMB167,496.0m (Q2-2026 6-K, 'net cash (total cash and cash equivalents, current and non-current time deposits and restricted cash, as well as short-term investments balance, minus loans) totaled RMB167.5 billion'), reconciling from the balance sheet: cash 22,814.5 + current time deposits 101,978.6 + restricted cash 4,447.5 + short-term investments 50,599.6 + non-current time deposits 260.0 - short-term loans 12,604.2. Used: RMB150,089.1m after three itemised haircuts (10.4% total): restricted cash excluded (-4,447.5); short-term investments at 90% (-5,060) for demonstrated mark-to-market risk (Q2-2026 equity fair-value losses); 5% repatriation/PRC-withholding friction on the remainder (-7,899). Using the narrow figure (22,814.5 - 12,604.2 = RMB10.2bn) would understate value by ~RMB140bn = ~US$32/ADS; using the full stated figure would add RMB17.4bn = ~US$4.0/ADS. *** INTEREST INCOME *** RMB3,953.5m TTM stripped from the FCF base because net cash is ~3.5x the owner-FCF base; its matching asset is the net-cash bridge above. *** BUYBACKS *** RMB20.2bn FY2025: the flat count is funded, buybacks are value-neutral in this model. *** FY0 *** base_revenue is TTM to 2026-06-30 (RMB116,582.5m), the same base as 9999.HK; reported FCF TTM RMB50,036.6m includes a large working-capital inflow (FY2025: RMB8.4bn, ~116% of the revenue increase), which is why wc_capture is cut to 35%.

bear.rationale: Adopted unchanged from 9999.HK (including its 2026-08-29 revision of the revenue path from flat-to-negative to 5% -> 2%, because game revenue has never fallen in the recorded series outside the 2018-19 licensing freeze). The load-bearing bear assumption is MARGIN: the platform revenue-share gain reverses and EBITDA margin falls 39% -> 33%, back toward FY2022-23; SBC rises to 4% of revenue; tax at the 25% statutory rate.

base.rationale: Adopted unchanged from 9999.HK (2026-08-29). Mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth (H1-2026 +7.0%) decelerating to 3% by Y10 as the China market matures and Where Winds Meet / Marvel Rivals move from launch surge to steady live service. Adjusted EBITDA margin starts at the TTM 41.0% and drifts DOWN to 40.0%: the gaming gross-margin gain to 76.1% (from 70.2%) on lower platform revenue-sharing is treated as real but not compounding. Cash tax 22% -> 24%: the H1-2026 effective rate of 21.7% (vs 15.0%) is treated as structural (expiring preferential software/HNTE rates). Working-capital capture 35% of the revenue increase, far below FY2025's ~116%.

bull.rationale: Adopted unchanged from 9999.HK. Where Winds Meet and Marvel Rivals become durable evergreen global franchises and one of Ananta / Blood Message / Sea of Remnants lands as a further global hit, holding growth at 8-10% for five years; the platform revenue-share gain proves permanent and international self-published mix lifts EBITDA margin to 43.5%; tax settles at 22% as preferential rates are partly renewed.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Adopted from 9999.HK. Bear 25% (above the 15% default): China gaming carries a discrete-policy tail over ~70-75% of revenue (the December 2023 draft rule) plus VIE enforceability risk, and the base margin story rests on ONE mechanism -- the platform revenue-sharing cut -- which can reverse as fast as it arrived. Base 50%: management's mid-to-high single-digit framing and H1-2026 actuals. Bull 25% (below the 35% default): it needs two titles to prove evergreen AND a further pipeline hit AND a permanent margin gain, several independent things going right.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
